senses.gloss: m., pl. פּוּרְצָנִין, פּוּרְצָנֵי (פצץ, with anorg. ר; cmp. פַּרְצִידָא) kernels of grapes, a pomace of kernels.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 6:5">Targ. O. Num. VI, 5</cite> (ed. Vien. <he>פּוּרְצְ׳</he>); quot.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 34b:1">Ab. Zar. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ דארמאי</he> kernels sold by gentiles.
<cite ref="Pesachim 42b">Pes. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>בדפ׳</he> when the drink (<cite ref="V00648"><he>תָּמָד</he></cite>) is made of kernels.
Ber. 38ᵃ או דפ׳ קאמרת or do you mean (by trimma) a drink made of kernels? Ḥull. 110ᵃ בפ׳ over a fire made with kernels (cmp. סוּפְלֵי).
